title: Consistency, Replication, Fault Tolerance and Security
file: Lesson 04 - Consistency Replication and Fault Tolerance.html
src: Source: Lecture 04 (45 slides). The quorum rule (R + W > N) is a short standard addition to slide 26's note on tuning quorum sizes.
lead: Lecture 04: data-centric consistency (strict, sequential, causal, eventual) and client-centric guarantees, replication (push / pull, replica placement, trade-offs), CAP and PACELC, fault / error / failure, failure types, redundancy, process groups, heartbeat and gossip, reliable client-server and group communication, Two-Phase and Three-Phase Commit, and DFS security.
